questions.question:
Select the option in which the number-pair shares the same relationship as that is shared by the following number-pair.

15 ∶ 210
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: 1st number **×** (1st number - 1) = 2nd number.

For, 15 ∶ 210

→ 15 × (15 - 1) 

→ 15 × 14 = 210.

Now, checking the options,

Option 1) 16 ∶ 224

→ 16 × (16 - 1) 

→ 16 × 15 = 240 ≠ 224.

Option 2) 14 ∶ 196

→ 14 × (14 - 1) 

→ 14 × 13 = 182 ≠ 196.

Option 3) **22 ∶ 462**

**→ 22 × (22 - 1) **

**→ 22 × 21 = 462.**

Option 4) 13 ∶ 239

→ 13 × (13 - 1) 

→ 13 × 12 = 156 ≠ 239.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘SAGE’ is coded as ‘–8’, ‘TABS’ is coded as ‘0’. What is the code for ‘VERB’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Sum of first two digit's place value) - (Sum of last two digit's place value).

Now,

‘SAGE’ is coded as ‘-8’

⇒ [S(19) + A(1)] - [G(7) + E(5)]

⇒ 20 - 12 = 8.

And, '8 is written as -8'.

For, ‘TABS’ is coded as ‘0’

⇒ [T(20) + A(1)] - [B(2) + S(19)]

⇒ 21 - 21 = 0.

And, '0 is written as 0'.

Similarly, for** ‘VERB’**

**⇒ [V(22) + E(5)] - [R(18) + B(2)]**

**⇒ 27 - 20 = 7.**

**And, '7 is written as -7'.**

So, 'VERB' will be coded as '-7'.

Hence, the correct answer is "-7".

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No F is N.

II. All N are L.

**Conclusions:**

I. All F are L.

II. All N are F.

III. Some L are N.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. No F is N.

II. All N are L.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5247b4d59a4fdb207b12df292753570d2cba4346b6a9a3b4f487a024b4397f59.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All F are L - False (Because, All N are L and no F is N, so those part of N that is L will be definitely not F).

II. All N are F - False (Because, No F is N).

III. Some L are N - True (Because, All N are L so, some L are N is definitely true).

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given sets. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(40, 20, 82)

(36, 18, 74)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number - 2nd number) × 4 + 2 = 3rd number.

Now, for (40, 20, 82)

⇒ (40 - 20) × 4 + 2

⇒ 20 × 4 + 2 = 82.

For, (36, 18, 74)

⇒ (36 - 18) × 4 + 2

⇒ 18 × 4 + 2 = 74.

Similarly, for **(212, 106, 426)**

⇒ (212 - 106) × 4 + 2

⇒ 106 × 4 + 2 = 426.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Which two numbers (not digits) should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0
questions.solution:
Given equation: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 1 and 0

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 5 - __**6 ÷ 3**__ × 9 + 0 = 1

⇒ 5 - __**2 × 9**__ + 0 = 1

⇒ __**5**__ - 18 __**+ 0**__ = 1

⇒ __5 - 18__ = 1

⇒ - 13 ≠ 1

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 6 and 9

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 5 - __**9 ÷ 3**__ × 6 + 1 = 0

⇒ 5 - __**3 × 6**__ + 1 = 0

⇒ __**5**__ - 18 __**+ 1**__ = 0

⇒ __6 - 18__ = 0

⇒ - 12 ≠ 0

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 3) 5 and 9**

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 9 - __**6 ÷ 3**__ × 5 + 1 = 0

⇒ 9 - __**2 × 5**__ + 1 = 0

⇒ __**9**__ - 10 __**+ 1**__ = 0

⇒ __10 - 10__ = 0

**⇒ 0 = 0**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 4) 6 and 3

Given: 5 - 6 ÷ 3 × 9 + 1 = 0

After interchanging the numbers we get;

⇒ 5 - __**3 ÷ 6**__ × 9 + 1 = 0

⇒ 5 - __**0.5 × 9**__ + 1 = 0

⇒ __**5**__ - 4.5 __**+ 1**__ = 0

⇒ __6 - 4.5__ = 0

⇒ 1.5 ≠ 0

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.

E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(34, 17, 51)

(46, 23, 69)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:-** Second Number = First Number ÷ 2**

**And, Third Number = First Number + Second Number.**

(34, 17, 51):

→ 17 = 34 ÷ 2

→ 51 = 34 + 17

(46, 23, 69):

→ 23 = 46 ÷ 2

→ 69 = 46 + 23

Let's check each option as per the logic:

 
• (68, 34, 204):

→ 34 = 68 ÷ 2

→ 204 ≠ 68 + 34 ⇒ Doesn't satisfy the logic.

 
• (54, 27, 108):

→ 27 = 54 ÷ 2

→ 108 ≠ 54 + 27 ⇒ Doesn't satisfy the logic.

 
• **(72, 36, 108):**

**→ 36 = 72 ÷ 2**

**→ 108 = 72 + 36 ⇒ Satisfies the logic.**

 
• (44, 22, 88):

→ 22 = 44 ÷ 2

→ 88 ≠ 44 + 22 ⇒ Doesn't satisfy the logic.

Here, we can see that only Option 3 satisfies the logic.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
